description: This file defines a class for a plus-shaped marker used in the Image_Graph PEAR package, including methods for drawing the marker on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Plus
classes.description: A class representing a plus-shaped marker for graph plotting, extending the Image_Graph_Marker base class.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws a plus-shaped marker on the canvas at specified (x, y) coordinates, with optional data values.
